items.heading: In Most Categories, a Subscription
items.text: In most categories, a subscription means a recurring charge, monthly or annual, that keeps billing automatically until it is actively cancelled. It usually buys ongoing access to something: a tool, a library of content, or a standing relationship you can dip into whenever you want. The appeal is a lower cost to start and the flexibility to walk away without a big up-front commitment.

items.heading: Neither Model Is Universally Better
items.text: Neither model is universally better. Here is what each one is actually optimised for, without pretending the package is a strictly superior version of a subscription.

items.heading: A Real Subscription Model Does
items.text: A real subscription model does have real advantages elsewhere, lower entry cost, cancel anytime, and that trade-off is worth saying plainly rather than pretending it doesn't exist.
